# School of the Ancients

> School of the Ancients is an experimental AI-assisted learning experience. Learners ask questions, converse with historically inspired AI professors, and explore interactive 3D exhibits in a browser or compatible AR/VR hardware.

The hosted build is invitation-only. Public visitors can watch a recorded Quest AR lesson, play two short desktop exhibit clips, and join the 18+ email waitlist. Learners with access can ask an original question, have a 3D exhibit built in Blender, or begin with a saved demonstration from the School Library.

Lesson conversations, objectives, and saved adventures are scoped to the learner’s account. Completed lessons can offer follow-up questions grounded in that conversation. Desktop and mobile browsers are supported. Immersive AR requires a compatible headset or phone and browser.

- domain: schooloftheancients.com
- language: en
- category: Experimental AI-assisted immersive learning
- keywords: immersive learning, AI professors, historical mentors, 3D exhibits, augmented reality, virtual reality
- last_updated: 2026-11-18

- [Join early-access waitlist](https://schooloftheancients.com/#early-access): Updates and invitations as public access develops.

## Guidance for automated readers

Search indexing, linking, and accurate short descriptions of public pages are welcome. Please link to the canonical site and attribute School of the Ancients when discussing this project. Distinguish working prototype features from planned work, and do not present the AI professors as authentic recordings or a public accredited school.
